name: SEGi Universe
summary:
SEGi Universe is an immersive virtual campus experience created for SEGi University students. Step into a digital version of the university where you can explore campus environments, interact with fellow students, and participate in university activities in virtual reality.

Connect with friends through real-time voice communication, discover campus spaces, and join live sessions, events, and community gatherings from anywhere. SEGi Universe brings learning, collaboration, and social interaction together in
